text: I will pay my rent on Friday, and then I will bake bread.
model_text: Reads the labels and the text together, as one input, and gives each label a score for how well it fits. It writes no text. It can only choose from the labels you sent.

replies.title: One label
replies.rule: The probabilities are shared between the labels and add up to 1 (softmax). There is no threshold: the label with the highest probability is chosen.

replies.title: Several labels
replies.rule: Each label gets its own probability from 0 to 1 (sigmoid), so they do not add up to 1. Every label above the threshold is chosen.
